message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout that caught me off guard. I scrambled to find our flashlights, but I was surprised to see I hadn’t charged our power bank in ages! Luckily, I had a backup lantern that lit up the whole room and kept the kids entertained with shadow puppets. It turned into a cozy family night instead of a panic. A small reminder that having a few reliable light sources can turn an unexpected moment into a fun memory. Have you ever had a blackout turn into a surprise adventure?
